name: Fabworks
how_read: Hand-collected: messages the instant-quote page showed for reference parts batch 01, recorded by the owner's agent on 2026-11-19 (reference_parts/batch01/results/web_benchmark_2026-11-19.csv). No published design guide was read.

rules.measured: formed flange length from the apex (outside mould line) of the bend
rules.source_url_note: site home: the quote page is a session page whose URL was not recorded
rules.note: One data point (RP03, whose 6.0 mm outside flange fails under any definition). Fabworks does not say where it measures; the formed length from the apex is used, the longest of the three usual measures, so passing this rule is not proof Fabworks accepts the flange. 0.367" equals SendCutSend's flat minimum for .125" stock (die .630"), which suggests a wider die than SendCutSend's for .090".
rules.quote: ERROR (Fix before ordering): Flange too short | Bending, 1 bend | This flange is too short to bend: it needs to be at least 0.367″ at this thickness. Lengthen it, or choose a thinner sheet.

rules.measured: formed distance from the bend's tangent line to the nearest edge of a hole or cut-out in the flange
rules.source_url_note: site home: the quote page is a session page whose URL was not recorded
rules.note: Derived from one data point: RP03's 5.5 mm hole edge is 1.5 mm from the bend tangent (reference_parts/batch01/MANIFEST.md) and Fabworks asked for 0.138" (3.505 mm) more, so about 5.0 mm from the tangent at 5052 .090" with a 2.29 mm inside radius. Whether the figure scales with thickness, radius or cut-out size, and whether Fabworks measures from the tangent, the bend line or the die line, is not known; edges near a bend (not only cut-outs) are covered by Fabworks' message but not measured here.
rules.quote: WARNING (Worth a look): Major deformation | Bending, 1 bend | Major deformation: this bend will deform the part near a cutout or edge, because the sheet isn’t supported there while it bends. To avoid it, move the cutout or edge 0.138″ further from the bend.
